decisions.statement: Where a keychain item sits decides whether the widget extension can read that item.
An item in the app's default domain satisfies the probe while the extension is refused that item.
A shell that says no keychain domain reads as unsaid.
An unsaid keychain domain mints the secret again.
The recovery mark is a timestamp rather than a credential.
The recovery mark is held in localStorage rather than in the keychain.
The recovery mark is keyed per account.
The secret never enters this process.
A shell with no `present` method answers unanswered.
The keychain is emptied before another secret is minted.
A device holding nothing mints on its next launch.
A clear that fails stops the recovery and writes no mark.
The native store deletes before the store adds.
A secret the admission route refuses is let go of on the next launch.
A secret the server no longer accepts looks the same as a good secret from the keychain.
This module is the only caller of the native keychain clear.
A null identity after a render that had an identity is the only edge the clear is reached on.
A whole-document reload boots with no earlier identity to compare against.

definition: the device secret minted and kept in the shell's keychain
